title: 第八章 暗道阴冷 往事犹在第九章 历经万险 盗宝救父
content_zh:
群芳阁楼，地底暗道，湿气厚重，冷风蚀骨。
小虫子像一片皱巴巴的枯叶般没精打采地蜷缩在一块青石上，晕了过去。昏暗的地道里，两抹烛火跳跃不定。细细打量过去，小虫子**的地方四面阴暗潮湿，洞壁上还挂着密密麻麻的水珠。在小虫子旁边有一口棺材，棺材里面，一张面灰如纸、老态龙钟的面目映入眼帘。他鬓角斑白，颔须冉冉，头戴紫云祥冠，脚塌七星步履。身周翡翠、明珠环饰，上盖秀衣华缎。抬眼望去，却正是万锦王！
摇摆不定的光影里，两个身影负手而立。其中一人是万青城，另一个人身材矮小，披着一块番邦长布衣，梳着两缕细长的辫子。长相猥琐，身材佝偻，面容蜡黄，一看便是外族人士。
万青城一脸惊慌，战战兢兢的问道：“刚才宝物为何爆出如此蓬勃戾气？还有，那一声怪啸是怎么一回事？”
“嘶。。。”这名怪人吸了一口冷气，眉头紧锁，暗下思忖。万青城看到他来回踱步，心也着急，紧紧地盯着这个怪人。
“本族之血？”他脱口而出，然后又定定神继续说道：“不可能啊？！这小子不是！肯定不是！”他围绕着小虫子，上下打量一番。
“他也是桑梭族人？不会的！不会的！咳、咳、咳。。。”矮个子激动万分，剧烈地咳嗽起来，随后“哇”地一声竟咳出一口黑血。
万青城赶忙上前扶住了矮个子。令人惊异的是他竟然开口说道：“哥哥，你这急火攻心！千万别着急，坐下休息会。”（要知道万青城可是独子啊！）这位被叫做哥哥的怪人在万青城的搀扶下，慢慢坐在了旁边的一张藤椅上。
“这就是一个小杂碎。不碍事的。我料理了他！”万青城说罢，抽出宝剑，提剑便向小虫子刺了过去。
“嗌”，这个怪人抬起左手，朝万青城摆了摆。“我这一路来都是逃亡，易容，被追杀，被暗算。可谓是九死一生。现在身上体无完肤，到处都是伤口。幽冥鬼府和蝶门宗派出的杀手层出不穷，这也算我命不该绝，才勉强活到今天。上个月‘鱼蛇二老’的当心一掌，拍的我肺腑剧震，险些丧命，直至今日仍是疼痛难当。现在我元气流失，精血淤塞，也正好需要这个男孩来当我的点心！处子之血的味道也是相当不错的！”说完他从嘴里吐出一条颇为怪异的物事。定睛看去那竟然是一条舌头。但不同的是这条舌头是如此之长，不像是人的舌头，倒像是驴或者是马的舌头。长长地舌头忽而曲卷忽而伸直，看上去既恶心又恐怖。
“哥哥，这些年，你受苦了。”万青城关切道。
那位怪人叹了口气，说道：“我自幼天资志聪颖，对于江湖各路武学也颇有天赋。因父亲交友广泛，不少武林高手也是父亲体己。但凡父亲能请到家中的武林人士，都会让他们亲自指导我习武。各位叔伯对我悉心**，让我的武功日进千里。在我十一岁那年便打败京师不少高手，曾名噪一时，那时候父亲对我赞许不已，全家人都以我为傲。然而，好景不长，十三岁那年，也就是永乐十八年，燕王朱棣设立东厂。东厂初建，广招各路能人异士，而这时候的东厂番子也盯上了我们万家。父亲虽然爱子如命，但迫于朝廷压力，不得不将我送出。我进入的是东厂最为神秘、最具权利的部门，名唤‘血煞门’。进入‘血煞门’有一个规矩，那便是没有身份，没有自由。于是，我‘万青山’的身份便随着步入‘血煞门’的那一刻死掉，当时外人都传言我死于肺疾。我和父亲都清楚，一入‘血煞门’便什么都不是了，再也没有家，也再不能回家。父亲十多年来，对我的悉心**、给予的厚望都瞬间化作乌有，我的离去对于父亲是一个重大的打击！我走后不久，父亲便一病不起，我颇为挂心。多年来我行走江湖，暗为东厂特务，四处奔波，没有一晚不思念父亲。直到十四年前，也就是永乐二十年，老皇上朱棣病重，得知自己时日不多，所以暗中指派‘血煞门’四处打探、收罗长生不老之方。东厂制度严密，‘血煞门’直属皇上，所以此事只是皇上一人得知。当时有人传言，西迁入境的桑梭族人有‘圣灵’至宝，也就是江湖人传言的‘白玉观音’，此物可以让人长生不老，益寿延年。但传言，桑梭族早已全部灭亡，所以这个任务被认为是最不可能的任务！但就在永乐二十年，‘血煞门’依然发动数名门中好手开始了行动，意在打探桑梭族，获得宝物。我也是其中一员，由于东厂势力庞大，耳目众多，再加上我多年历练的经验。终于，我竟然找到了行踪诡秘的桑梭族，他们竟然还活着。而且我还成功混入了桑梭族中！”
“原来，桑梭族并没有灭亡啊？”万青城问道。
“恩，咳、咳、咳、咳，据我所知桑梭族人一百年前便从西域迁徙到中原，来到中原后不久，便被不明身份人士，几乎连根斩除。想必也是桑梭族人瑰宝、秘密太多，招人嫉羡。我所知道的桑梭族人都颇为精明，对于汉文化也甚是了解。其现在的族人领袖花百漾一手创立了蝶门宗威震四方，并且以此来掩饰桑梭族人的身份。”
“什么？蝶门宗就是桑梭族人？”
“不，只能说其中一部分人是。蝶门宗的管事大部分都是桑梭族人。我潜入族中数年，颇费周折，才混到位列蝶门宗‘四大长老’之一的黑蝠长老的地位。但是，蝶门宗并不是那么简单，除了有‘鱼蛇’两位长老之外，还有另外一位长老我至今不知！并且，宗主此人城府极深，行事极为诡秘，精明干练。我在蝶门宗虽已藏身数年，宗主仍不十分信任我。对于‘圣灵’一事也从未在我面前提起过。直到七年前，蝶门宗出了一件大事。。。”
content_en:
In the attic of Qunfang, there is a secret passage underground, the humidity is thick, and the cold wind corrodes the bones.
The little bug curled up listlessly on a piece of bluestone like a wrinkled dead leaf and fainted. In the dim tunnel, two candlelights danced uncertainly. Looking carefully, the place where the little bug lurked was surrounded by darkness and dampness, and there were dense drops of water hanging on the cave wall. There was a coffin next to the little bug. Inside the coffin, an old face with a face as gray as paper came into view. His temples are gray, his chin and beard are growing, he wears a purple cloud auspicious crown on his head, and walks with seven stars on his feet. The body is surrounded by emeralds and pearls, and covered with beautiful silk. Looking up, it was none other than King Wanjin!
In the swaying light and shadow, two figures stood with their hands behind their backs. One of them is Wanqingcheng, and the other is short in stature, wearing a long foreign cloth and two slender braids. With a wretched appearance, a stooped figure, and a sallow face, he looked like a foreigner at first glance.
Wanqingcheng looked panicked and asked tremblingly: "Why did the treasure burst out with such violent energy just now? Also, what was that strange roar?"
"Hiss..." This weirdo took a breath of air, frowned, and thought secretly. Wanqingcheng felt anxious when he saw him pacing back and forth, staring closely at this weirdo.
"Blood of my own family?" he blurted out, and then continued calmly: "Impossible?! This kid is not! Definitely not!" He surrounded the little insect and looked up and down.
"Is he also from the Sansuo tribe? No! No way! Cough, cough, cough..." The short man was so excited that he coughed violently, and then he coughed out a mouthful of black blood with a "wow" sound.
Wan Qingcheng hurriedly stepped forward to support the short man. What's surprising is that he actually said: "Brother, you are so anxious! Don't be anxious, sit down and rest for a while." (You must know that Wanqingcheng is an only son!) With Wanqingcheng's support, this weird man called brother slowly sat on a wicker chair next to him.
"This is just a little bastard. It's not a problem. I took care of him!" After Wanqingcheng said that, he drew out his sword and stabbed the little bug with the sword.
"Hey", this weirdo raised his left hand and waved it towards Wanqing City. "I have been on the run, disguised, hunted, and plotted all this time. It can be said that I have narrowly escaped death. Now my body is completely covered with wounds. There are endless killers sent by the Netherworld Ghost Mansion and the Butterfly Sect. This means that my life should not be cut off, so I can barely survive until today. Last month, the 'Fish and Snake Two Elders' A careful slap shocked my heart and almost killed me. The pain is still unbearable to this day. Now that I have lost my energy and blood, I just need this boy to be my snack! The taste of virgin blood is also quite good!" After that, he spat out a rather strange thing from his mouth. Taking a closer look, it turned out to be a tongue. But the difference is that this tongue is so long, it doesn't look like a human tongue, but more like a donkey or a horse's tongue. The long tongue curled and straightened, looking disgusting and terrifying.
"Brother, you have suffered a lot these years." Wan Qingcheng said with concern.
The weirdo sighed and said: "I have been talented and intelligent since I was a child, and I am also very talented in all kinds of martial arts. Because my father has a wide range of friends, many martial arts masters are also his disciples. Whenever my father can invite martial arts people at home, he will let them personally guide me in martial arts. My uncles took good care of me and made my martial arts improve by thousands of miles. When I was eleven years old, I defeated many masters in the capital, and I became famous for a while. At that time, my father was full of praise for me, and the whole family was very proud of me. However, the good times did not last long. When I was thirteen years old, that is, in the 18th year of Yongle, Dongchang was first established. At this time, Dongchang fans were also eyeing our family. Although my father loved his son, he had to send me out due to the pressure of the court. I entered the most mysterious and powerful department of Dongchang.The door is called "Blood Evil Gate". There is one rule when entering the 'Blood Demon Sect', that is, there is no identity and no freedom. As a result, my identity as Wanqingshan died the moment I entered the Blood Demon Sect. At that time, outsiders rumored that I died of lung disease. My father and I both know that once we enter the 'Blood Demon Gate', we will become nothing. We will no longer have a home, and we will never be able to go home again. For more than ten years, my father's careful care and high hopes for me were instantly wiped out. My passing was a huge blow to my father! Not long after I left, my father fell ill and I was very worried. For many years, I traveled around the world, secretly working as a spy for Dongchang, and running around. There was not a single night when I didn’t miss my father. Until fourteen years ago, the 20th year of Yongle, the old emperor Zhu Di was seriously ill and knew that he did not have much time left, so he secretly assigned the "Blood Evil Sect" to search around and collect the recipe for immortality. Dongchang has a strict system, and the 'Blood Evil Sect' belongs directly to the emperor, so only the emperor knows about this matter. At that time, it was rumored that the Sansuo people who migrated westward had the "Holy Spirit" treasure, which was the "White Jade Guanyin" rumored by Jianghu people. This thing could make people immortal and extend their lives. But it is rumored that the Sansuo tribe has long been wiped out, so this task is considered the most impossible one! But in the 20th year of Yongle, the 'Blood Evil Sect' still mobilized several masters from the sect to start an operation, with the intention of exploring the Sansuo clan and obtaining treasures. I am also one of them, due to the huge power of Dongchang, many eyes and ears, and my many years of experience. Finally, I found the mysterious Sansuo tribe, and they were still alive. And I also successfully blended into the Sansuo tribe! "
"It turns out that the Sansuo tribe did not perish? "Wan Qingcheng asked.
"Well, cough, cough, cough, cough, as far as I know, the Sansuo people migrated from the Western Regions to the Central Plains a hundred years ago. Not long after arriving in the Central Plains, they were almost eradicated by unknown people. It must be that the Sansuo people have so many treasures and secrets that they are envious. The Sansuo people I know are quite shrewd and know a lot about Chinese culture. Its current clan leader Hua Baiyang single-handedly founded the Diemen Sect to be powerful in all directions, and used this to conceal the identity of the Sansuo clan. "
"What? Are the Diemen Sect members of the Sansuo tribe? "
“No, I can only say that some of them are. Most of the stewards of Diemen Sect are members of the Sansuo tribe. I infiltrated the clan for several years, and after a lot of hard work, I managed to reach the position of Elder Black Bat, one of the "Four Elders" of Butterfly Sect. However, the Diemen Sect is not that simple. In addition to the two elders ‘Yu She’, there is another elder I still don’t know! Moreover, the sect leader is a man with deep knowledge, extremely secretive and shrewd. Although I have been hiding in Diemen Sect for several years, the sect leader still does not trust me very much. The "Holy Spirit" has never been mentioned to me. Until seven years ago, something big happened to the Diemen Sect. . . "
